nodes.title: ADR 0046: Own production release deployment in Orbit

description:
The agent can configure deployment steps and operate production releases from Orbit commands with live output and a reliable exit status.

## Scope

* In: deployment configuration, deploy, rollback, and release-list commands through the PHP SDK.
* Out: local SSH or shell execution, application command inference, automatic retry, and deployment history.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `instance:deployment-config INSTANCE` shows configuration and `instance:deployment-config INSTANCE --file=PATH` submits a complete JSON configuration; `instance:deploy INSTANCE`, `instance:rollback INSTANCE --release=NAME`, and `instance:releases INSTANCE` use the corresponding typed SDK operations. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/DeploymentCommandsTest.php`.
- [ ] Human deploy output renders phases and incremental stdout/stderr safely; `--json` emits the documented NDJSON events with no prompts or extra prose, and all commands preserve request IDs and shared safe errors. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/DeploymentCommandsTest.php`.
- [ ] Only a succeeded terminal result exits zero; failure or stream truncation exits nonzero and identifies the last known selected release when available, while Ctrl-C closes the stream and never submits another deployment. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/DeploymentCommandsTest.php`.
- [ ] A real operator-side command shows the first step’s output before its delayed completion, deploys updated branch code, and explicitly rolls back to a listed retained release without modifying persistent SQLite content. Proof: Incus action `deployment-cli-lifecycle`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes deployment commands, JSON stream output, configuration files, exit codes, and interruption, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/cli && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Expose production deployment configuration and streamed execution in the CLI
